name: dotfiles
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update; sudo apt-get install -y build-essential procps file zsh; sudo chown "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$DOTFILES/claude/.local" "$DOTFILES/codex/.local"

smoke:
set -eu
[[ $(uname -s) == Linux ]]
[[ $(getent passwd "$(id -un)" | cut -d: -f7) == */zsh ]]
[[ $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) == "$PWD" ]]
[[ "$DOTFILES" == "$PWD" ]]
command -v nvim tmux
nvim --headless "+lua if vim.v.errmsg ~= [[]] then vim.api.nvim_err_writeln(vim.v.errmsg); vim.cmd([[cquit 1]]) end" +qa
socket="dotfiles-smoke-$$"
trap 'tmux -L "$socket" kill-server 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
tmux -L "$socket" -f ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf new-session -d -s smoke
[[ $(tmux -L "$socket" show-option -gv prefix) == C-a ]]
print 'devcontainer smoke test passed'
